description: Source code for the RocketpodComponent class, managing targeting, firing, and safe mode behavior of a rocket pod in a game.

classes.name: RocketpodComponent
classes.description: Component class handling targeting, firing, and safe mode logic for a rocket pod in the game.

methods.name: HandlePrepareNetCode
methods.description: Updates entity flags for firing and lock-on status before network synchronization.

methods.name: HandlePowerUp
methods.description: Handles logic when the rocket pod powers up, including raising the head and managing shutters in safe mode.

methods.name: HandlePowerDown
methods.description: Handles logic when powering down, including removing targets and lowering the head.

methods.name: HandleDie
methods.description: Handles destruction logic, including setting destruction animation if in safe mode.

methods.name: Think
methods.description: Main update loop managing targeting, firing, and state transitions each frame.

methods.name: CompareTargets
methods.description: Compares two entities to determine priority based on line of sight, safety to shoot, and distance.

methods.name: SafeShot
methods.description: Checks if a shot in a given direction is safe from collateral damage.

methods.name: SafeShot (overload)
methods.description: Overloaded version that uses entity's current position and entity number.

methods.name: SafeShot
methods.description: Checks safety of shot given entity number, origin, and direction.

methods.name: EnemyClose
methods.description: Determines if an enemy is close enough to trigger safe mode.

methods.name: Shoot
methods.description: Fires a missile in the specified direction towards the current target.

methods.name: SetSafeMode
methods.description: Enables or disables safe mode, managing shutters and animations accordingly.
